headline_seed: Live updates: At least 111 dead following 7.4 magnitude earthquake in Colombia - CNN
draft_text: #BreakingMews A 7.4 quake struck western Colombia Monday. CNN reports at least 132 dead; ABC News confirms buildings collapsed in Cali, Pereira, and Manizales. Pereira alone counted dozens of deaths. President de la Espriella has mobilized emergency response.
